footnote_text: This security represents restricted stock units granted under the Issuer's 2026 Equity Incentive Plan as an initial grant to the Reporting Person in connection with his appointment as the Issuer's Chief Financial Officer. Each restricted stock unit represents a contingent right to receive one share of common stock of the Issuer. || This restricted stock unit grant vests over a period of thirty-six months in thirty-six equal installments beginning on September 3, 2026, in each case subject to the Reporting Person's continued service with the Issuer through the applicable vesting date.
